programme.title: Konosuba, Ep 10
programme.desc: High school student Kazuma Satou dies in an unexpectedly embarrassing accident and awakens in the presence of the goddess Aqua. She offers him the opportunity to be reincarnated in a fantasy world to defeat the Demon King. Before leaving, Kazuma is allowed to take one item with him, and he mischievously chooses Aqua herself. Together, the unlikely pair begin their new life in another world, quickly discovering that surviving there is far more difficult than they imagined. Filled with humor, fantasy, and parody, the episode introduces the eccentric characters and comedic adventures that define the series.

programme.title: Mr. Player

programme.title: Stylish Man: The Chef
programme.desc: Stylish Man: The Chef is one of Taiwan's most popular cooking variety shows, produced by Sanlih E-Television. Hosted by Sam Tseng and Genie Chuo alongside renowned chefs James and Wu Bing-Cheng, the program blends cooking demonstrations with celebrity competitions, themed culinary challenges, and humorous studio interactions. Viewers can learn practical recipes, professional cooking techniques, and kitchen tips while enjoying lighthearted entertainment and appearances by popular Taiwanese celebrities.

programme.title: Battle Tour
programme.desc: Battle Tour is a travel reality program where celebrity teams design and experience travel itineraries based on different themes and budgets. Throughout each episode, the teams visit popular attractions, discover hidden gems, enjoy local cuisine, and share practical travel tips. At the end of the journey, a panel and audience determine which itinerary offers the most memorable and worthwhile travel experience.

programme.title: Hot Door Night
programme.desc: Produced by Sanlih E-Television, Hot Door Night is a long-running variety program hosted by Jacky Wu alongside Chen Han-Dian and Lulu Huang. Each episode features celebrity guests competing in creative games, themed challenges, comedy segments, musical performances, and entertaining talk sessions. Blending humor, competition, and pop culture, the show has become one of Taiwan's highest-rated entertainment programs and has received multiple Golden Bell Award nominations and wins.

programme.title: The Sound Of Happiness
programme.desc: The Sound of Happiness follows the Wu family, led by a respected police officer and his supportive wife. Although he once dreamed of having a son to continue the family legacy, he instead dedicates his life to guiding his four daughters through the joys and hardships of adulthood. As their lives become intertwined with romance, ambition, betrayal, and family rivalries, the family faces countless trials that test their love and resilience. Blending heartfelt relationships with dramatic twists, the series delivers an emotional story about family bonds, forgiveness, and perseverance.

programme.title: The Tradition Story Of Taiwan
programme.desc: Discover the fascinating traditions and folklore of Taiwan in The Tradition Story of Taiwan. Each episode delves into ancient legends, local customs, religious beliefs, historical figures, and cultural practices that continue to shape Taiwanese identity today. Combining storytelling with visits to historical sites and local communities, the program offers viewers an engaging journey through Taiwan's diverse cultural heritage and enduring traditions.

programme.title: Ukiyoe Edo-Life
programme.desc: Centuries ago, Tokyo was known as Edo. More than a million people enjoyed life in this small but abundant city. They live on in ukiyo-e woodblock prints. Each episode is a deep dive into a single print, and an exploration of the soul of Old Tokyo. That is how the people of Edo themselves enjoyed this mass-produced medium.

programme.title: Game Planet
programme.desc: As growth in the game industry accelerates, game makers pursue increased global attention through new strategies. Japanese game companies, once undisputed champions, now face competition to survive.

programme.title: Herbal Symphony: Spring
programme.desc: As spring arrives, Japan's oldest private herb garden in Uda, Nara Prefecture, bursts into life. This program tells the story of the people who follow in the footsteps of their ancestors to preserve these herbs.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: The hosts present the latest news and developments from the world of sports, weather, international politics and economy.

programme.title: Game-Genome
programme.desc: Treating video games as a cultural medium, GAME GENOME takes an in-depth look at influential titles from Japan and around the world. The series explores their lasting appeal, the creative vision behind them, and the impact they have had on players across generations.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: The hosts present the latest news and developments from the world of sports, weather, international politics and economy.

programme.title: Cycle Around Japan Highlights
programme.desc: Selected highlights of CYCLE AROUND JAPAN! Bicycle through inspiring scenery, meet the locals and discover living traditions of a hidden Japan.

programme.title: I Love 'Mee'
programme.desc: This heartwarming animated series features five-year-old Mee. "Why do we wear underpants?" "Why doesn't my friend want to be tickled?" Everyday questions spark Mee's imagination, leading to wonderful thought experiments that help Mee learn more about Mee's self!

programme.title: Design Ah Neo: Toilet Paper
programme.desc: Design is fun! Design feels good! Cutting-edge images and music guide children to enjoy exploring the ideas and tweaks in the designs all around us. An episode on Toilet Paper.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: The hosts present the latest news and developments from the world of sports, weather, international politics and economy.

programme.title: J-Melo
programme.desc: Experience Japanese music in all its diversity! With unmissable performances and interviews with artists in every imaginable genre, J-MELO is your invitation to immerse yourself in the sounds of Japan.

programme.title: Little Charo
programme.desc: Little Charo is an animation series about a Japanese dog who got lost in NY. "I want to see my owner again!" Charo starts his adventure back home. Season 2-7.

programme.title: Japanology Plus
programme.desc: Fresh insights into Japan. Stories behind Japanese life and culture through the eyes of Peter Barakan, a 50-year resident and watcher of Japan.

programme.title: A Cat's-Eye View Of Japan
programme.desc: Globe-trotting wildlife photographer and filmmaker, Iwago Mitsuaki, offers the best of a vast collection of cat footage he took in Japan. On this unique trip around the country, discover the lesser-known charms and customs of regions through the eyes of cats!

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: The hosts present the latest news and developments from the world of sports, weather, international politics and economy.

programme.title: Ramen Japan
programme.desc: Ramen is a savory combination of umami-packed broth and perfectly cooked noodles. This program offers an encyclopedic view of this delectable dish, taking you on a journey across Japan to discover ever-evolving local variations. Diva couldn't resist asking Nada about the figure of "Abang", but Nurul always stopped her. Realizing how antagonistic Nada is with Ikatan Cinta, Diva and Nurul speculate that Diva's biological father played a role in Ikatan Cinta.

programme.title: Melody Of Love 2022
programme.desc: Journey of Hary Tanoesoedibjo and Liliana Tanoesoedibjo from early struggle & affection, to unite in marriage. Hary, a brave and hardworking man, who falls in love with Liliana, a gentle and multitalented girl, in a friends birthday party. That night was the beginning of their love story which continued to life story of their marriage with trials and struggles.

programme.title: Beyond Creator Indonesian Youtubers S1 E6
programme.desc: Jovi Adhiguna Hunter, an entrepreneur as well as a content creator who often creates fashion, beauty, lifestyle and F&B contents. Lifni Sanders, commonly known as Livjunkie, a woman of Papuan and Chinese has a profession as a content creator by using makeup and skincare as contents.

programme.title: Bedah Rumah Lagi S4 E7
programme.desc: Bedah Rumah Lagi is a television program that transforms uninhabitable homes of underprivileged families into safe and comfortable living spaces, while also presenting stories of struggle and new hope for the families.

programme.title: Preman Pensiun - Manusia Merdeka
programme.desc: Preman Pensiun - Manusia Merdeka

programme.title: Kiko
programme.desc: Kiko tells of a child of a goldfish who is very independent, even though he is an only child. Kiko who is always cheerful has four good friends, namely Lola the discus fish, Ting Ting the crab, Patino the catfish and Poli the betta fish. On the other hand, the antagonists, Karkus the catfish and Pupus the eel, always make Kiko's life chaotic. One day, the lake where Kiko lives is polluted due to the reckless acts of humans, causing Kiko and friends to turn into mutants.

programme.title: Lintas iNews Siang
programme.desc: A news program that airs every afternoon, conveying the facts as they are, without any manipulation, and presenting the latest and most up-to-date news.

programme.title: Seleb On News
programme.desc: An infotainment program that reports the latest information and rumors about Indonesian celebrities.

programme.title: Sumber Rezeki The Series S1 E1
programme.desc: Udin and Ujang comes from a small village and had dreams to become Pro E-Sports Players - so they finally decided to take the bold move to relocate to Jakarta. They were one step away from their dreams but first - they needed to find the address to their designated boarding house.

programme.title: Sumber Rezeki The Series S1 E2
programme.desc: Becoming Pro-Players was not as easy as they thought it would be. Udin and Ujang approached several Esports clubs and were rejected a every opportunity. On the verge of giving up, Udin and Ujang returned to their hometown to bury all their dreams.

programme.title: Sumber Rezeki The Series S1 E3
programme.desc: Inspired by their gaming idol, Udin and Ujang returned on their path in pursuit of their Pror-Player dreams. Udin and Ujang started settling in the Maju boarding house with the companionship from a security guard on post, and a strange street dealer who ends up becoming one of their good friends.

programme.title: Sumber Rezeki The Series S1 E4
programme.desc: Udin and Ujang were finally admitted to the PMJC tournament! Ujang was optimist that PMJC was the way up to his dreams, but on the contrary, things turned out differently. Not having any connections in Jakarta was a major obstacle for him to form a proper gaming squad. So they turned to Roy and Dede, but Dede was not so cooperative.

programme.title: Sumber Rezeki The Series S1 E5
programme.desc: Udin and Ujang finally succeeds in getting Dede to join their squad, Sumber Rezeki. In spite of the limitations of their current squad, they were still able to make it through the PMJC qualifications. Udin, who already knew that Mawar was participating in the tournament, was even more eager to get top rank.

programme.title: Sumber Rezeki The Series S1 E6
programme.desc: Udin gets closer to Mawar, but this makes Melati even more annoyed. While Udin was falling for Mawar, he started losing focus of his dreams. Udin sacrificed his gaming squad and his friends for Mawar and ends up ruining everything. Sumber Rezeki fails to close the distance with the Golden Rose.

programme.title: Sumber Rezeki The Series S1 E7
programme.desc: Because Udin and Ujang are childhood friends, it was an uneasy situation for Udin to become rivals with Ujang. Udin realized that Roy and Dede were the only other friends that he has in Jakarta. Udin made Melati upset. Udin regretted his actions and tries to improve his relationship with his friends.

programme.title: Sumber Rezeki The Series S1 E8
programme.desc: Sumber Rezeki managed to secure their position until the last day of PMJC. Sumber Rezeki must overtake the throne of winning streak champions, the Golden Rose. But Sumber Rezeki lacked 1 player, as Roy had to return home to his sick mother. Melati becomes an additional player to replace Roy. Will Sumber Rezeki finally succeed in winning the PMJC Tournaments?

programme.title: Sopir Eneng Dunia Akhirat
programme.desc: Sopir Eneng Dunia Akhirat tells the story of Eneng, a girl who loves shopping for expensive items, so much so that her mother limits her allowance and eventually hires a driver to take her everywhere.

programme.desc: An Indonesian animation based on the famous soap opera on MNCTV, Si Entong, which aired in 2005.

programme.title: Pelangi di Rumah Rinai
programme.desc: While her father was framed in jail, Rinais mother became unfaithful. A problematic childhood eventually finds its silver lining.
